name: Tongkat ali

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A standardised root extract of Eurycoma longifolia taken for testosterone and stress effects. Studies are small and heterogeneous; product standardisation varies widely between manufacturers.

systems.note: Taken for its reported effect on testosterone; the intended effect, on thin and heterogeneous evidence.
Botanical extract with variable standardisation and no approved labelling.
